type ModelTaskSnapshot = Mapping[str, FrozenJsonValue]

MODEL_TASK_SCHEMA_SHA256 = "@@SCHEMA_SHA256@@"
_MODEL_TASK_SCHEMA: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(r"""@@SCHEMA_JSON@@""")
_DANGEROUS_KEYS = frozenset({"__proto__", "constructor", "prototype"})
_MAX_COLLECTION_ITEMS = 4096


def _record(value: object) -> Mapping[str, Any] | None:
    if not isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return None
    candidate = cast(Mapping[object, Any], value)
    if any(not isinstance(key, str) or key in _DANGEROUS_KEYS for key in candidate):
        return None
    return cast(Mapping[str, Any], value)


def _deep_equal(left: object, right: object) -> bool:
    return left == right and type(left) is type(right)


def _stable_json(value: object) -> str:
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        candidate = cast(Mapping[str, object], value)
        return "{" + ",".join(f"{json.dumps(key)}:{_stable_json(candidate[key])}" for key in sorted(candidate)) + "}"
    if isinstance(value, Sequence) and not isinstance(value, str | bytes | bytearray):
        return "[" + ",".join(_stable_json(item) for item in value) + "]"
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)


def _owned_frozen(value: object) -> object:
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        candidate = _record(value)
        if candidate is None:
            raise ValueError("model task object contains unsafe keys")
        if len(candidate) > _MAX_COLLECTION_ITEMS:
            raise ValueError("model task object exceeds bound")
        return MappingProxyType({key: _owned_frozen(item) for key, item in candidate.items()})
    if isinstance(value, Sequence) and not isinstance(value, str | bytes | bytearray):
        if len(value) > _MAX_COLLECTION_ITEMS:
            raise ValueError("model task collection exceeds bound")
        return tuple(_owned_frozen(item) for item in value)
    return value


def _schema_record(value: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError("generated model task schema is malformed")
    return cast(dict[str, Any], value)


def _resolve_reference(reference: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
    prefix = "#/$defs/"
    if not isinstance(reference, str) or not reference.startswith(prefix):
        raise ValueError("unsupported model task schema reference")
    definitions = _schema_record(_MODEL_TASK_SCHEMA["$defs"])
    return _schema_record(definitions[reference[len(prefix) :]])


def _type_matches(value: object, kind: object) -> bool:
    if kind == "null":
        return value is None
    if kind == "boolean":
        return isinstance(value, bool)
    if kind == "integer":
        return (
            isinstance(value, int | float)
            and not isinstance(value, bool)
            and math.isfinite(value)
            and float(value).is_integer()
            and abs(value) <= 9_007_199_254_740_991
        )
    if kind == "number":
        return isinstance(value, int | float) and not isinstance(value, bool) and math.isfinite(value)
    if kind == "string":
        return isinstance(value, str)
    if kind == "array":
        return isinstance(value, Sequence) and not isinstance(value, str | bytes | bytearray)
    if kind == "object":
        return _record(value) is not None
    return False


def _validation_errors(value: object, node: dict[str, Any], path: str) -> list[str]:
    if "$ref" in node:
        return _validation_errors(value, _resolve_reference(node["$ref"]), path)
    errors: list[str] = []
    if "const" in node and not _deep_equal(value, node["const"]):
        errors.append(f"{path}: const")
    enum = node.get("enum")
    if isinstance(enum, list) and not any(_deep_equal(value, item) for item in enum):
        errors.append(f"{path}: enum")
    alternatives = node.get("oneOf")
    if isinstance(alternatives, list):
        matches = sum(not _validation_errors(value, _schema_record(item), path) for item in alternatives)
        if matches != 1:
            errors.append(f"{path}: alternatives")
    raw_types = node.get("type")
    types = raw_types if isinstance(raw_types, list) else [] if raw_types is None else [raw_types]
    if types and not any(_type_matches(value, kind) for kind in types):
        errors.append(f"{path}: type")
    if isinstance(value, int | float) and not isinstance(value, bool) and math.isfinite(value):
        if isinstance(node.get("minimum"), int | float) and value < node["minimum"]:
            errors.append(f"{path}: minimum")
        if isinstance(node.get("maximum"), int | float) and value > node["maximum"]:
            errors.append(f"{path}: maximum")
    if isinstance(value, str):
        if isinstance(node.get("minLength"), int) and len(value) < node["minLength"]:
            errors.append(f"{path}: minLength")
        if isinstance(node.get("maxLength"), int) and len(value) > node["maxLength"]:
            errors.append(f"{path}: maxLength")
        if isinstance(node.get("pattern"), str) and re.search(node["pattern"], value) is None:
            errors.append(f"{path}: pattern")
    if isinstance(value, Sequence) and not isinstance(value, str | bytes | bytearray):
        if isinstance(node.get("minItems"), int) and len(value) < node["minItems"]:
            errors.append(f"{path}: minItems")
        if isinstance(node.get("maxItems"), int) and len(value) > node["maxItems"]:
            return [*errors, f"{path}: maxItems"]
        if node.get("uniqueItems") is True and len({_stable_json(item) for item in value}) != len(value):
            errors.append(f"{path}: uniqueItems")
        if isinstance(node.get("items"), dict):
            for index, item in enumerate(value):
                errors.extend(_validation_errors(item, node["items"], f"{path}/{index}"))
    candidate = _record(value)
    if candidate is not None and ("object" in types or isinstance(node.get("properties"), dict)):
        required = node.get("required", [])
        if isinstance(required, list):
            for key in required:
                if isinstance(key, str) and key not in candidate:
                    errors.append(f"{path}/{key}: required")
        properties = node.get("properties", {})
        if not isinstance(properties, dict):
            raise ValueError("generated model task schema properties are malformed")
        if node.get("additionalProperties") is False:
            for key in candidate:
                if key not in properties:
                    errors.append(f"{path}/{key}: additional property")
        for key, property_schema in properties.items():
            if key in candidate:
                errors.extend(_validation_errors(candidate[key], _schema_record(property_schema), f"{path}/{key}"))
    return errors


def _definition(name: Literal["ModelTaskSpec", "ModelResultEnvelope"]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return _schema_record(_schema_record(_MODEL_TASK_SCHEMA["$defs"])[name])


def _content_references(value: object) -> tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]:
    found: list[Mapping[str, Any]] = []

    def visit(item: object) -> None:
        if isinstance(item, Sequence) and not isinstance(item, str | bytes | bytearray):
            for child in item:
                visit(child)
            return
        candidate = _record(item)
        if candidate is None:
            return
        if all(isinstance(candidate.get(key), str) for key in ("aggregateId", "revisionId", "contentHash", "role")):
            found.append(candidate)
        for child in candidate.values():
            visit(child)

    visit(value)
    return tuple(found)


def model_task_errors(value: object) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    try:
        errors = _validation_errors(value, _definition("ModelTaskSpec"), "$")
    except KeyError, TypeError, ValueError:
        return ("model-task-structure-invalid",)
    if errors:
        return tuple(errors)
    task = cast(Mapping[str, Any], value)
    task_input = cast(Mapping[str, Any], task["input"])
    semantic_errors: list[str] = []
    if task_input["kind"] != task["taskKind"]:
        semantic_errors.append("task-input-kind-matches-task-kind")
    if task_input["kind"] == "reranking" and task_input["topK"] > len(task_input["candidates"]):
        semantic_errors.append("reranking-top-k-within-candidate-count")
    return tuple(semantic_errors)


def decode_model_task(value: object) -> ModelTaskSnapshot | None:
    try:
        owned = _owned_frozen(value)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    if model_task_errors(owned):
        return None
    return cast(ModelTaskSnapshot, owned)


def assess_model_task(value: object, supported_features: Sequence[str]) -> ModelTaskSnapshot:
    task = decode_model_task(value)
    if task is None:
        return cast(
            ModelTaskSnapshot,
            _owned_frozen({"supported": False, "diagnosticCode": "model-task-invalid", "unsupportedFeatures": []}),
        )
    requirements = cast(Mapping[str, Any], task["requirements"])
    required = cast(Sequence[str], requirements["requiredFeatures"])
    unsupported = sorted(feature for feature in required if feature not in frozenset(supported_features))
    return cast(
        ModelTaskSnapshot,
        _owned_frozen(
            {
                "supported": not unsupported,
                "diagnosticCode": "model-task-supported" if not unsupported else "model-task-feature-unsupported",
                "unsupportedFeatures": unsupported,
            }
        ),
    )


def _selected_route_matches_pin(route: Mapping[str, Any], pin: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
    return all(
        route.get(key) == pin.get(key)
        for key in (
            "providerId",
            "providerVersion",
            "modelId",
            "modelVersion",
            "runtimeId",
            "runtimeVersion",
            "configurationHash",
            "evaluationId",
            "evaluationVersion",
        )
    )


def _indexed_output_errors(task: Mapping[str, Any], result: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    task_input = cast(Mapping[str, Any], task["input"])
    output = _record(result["output"])
    if output is None:
        return []
    errors: list[str] = []
    if task["taskKind"] == "reranking":
        items = cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], output["items"])
        candidates = cast(Sequence[object], task_input["candidates"])
        indices = [cast(int, item["inputIndex"]) for item in items]
        if (
            len(items) > cast(int, task_input["topK"])
            or len(items) > len(candidates)
            or any(index >= len(candidates) for index in indices)
            or len(set(indices)) != len(indices)
        ):
            errors.append("reranking-output-closes-over-candidates")
    if task["taskKind"] == "classification":
        items = cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], output["items"])
        inputs = cast(Sequence[object], task_input["items"])
        labels = frozenset(cast(Sequence[str], task_input["labels"]))
        identities = [(item["inputIndex"], item["label"]) for item in items]
        if any(cast(int, item["inputIndex"]) >= len(inputs) or item["label"] not in labels for item in items) or len(
            set(identities)
        ) != len(identities):
            errors.append("classification-output-closes-over-items-and-labels")
    if task["taskKind"] == "nli":
        scores = cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], output["scores"])
        labels = frozenset({"entailment", "contradiction", "neutral", "uncertain"})
        score_labels = [cast(str, item["label"]) for item in scores]
        if (
            any(item["inputIndex"] != 0 or item["label"] not in labels for item in scores)
            or len(set(score_labels)) != len(score_labels)
            or output["label"] not in score_labels
        ):
            errors.append("nli-output-closes-over-task")
    if task["taskKind"] == "moderation":
        items = cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], output["items"])
        inputs = cast(Sequence[object], task_input["items"])
        identities = [(item["inputIndex"], item["label"]) for item in items]
        if any(cast(int, item["inputIndex"]) >= len(inputs) for item in items) or len(set(identities)) != len(
            identities
        ):
            errors.append("moderation-output-closes-over-items")
    return errors


def model_result_errors(task_value: object, result_value: object) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    task = decode_model_task(task_value)
    if task is None:
        return ("model-result-task-invalid",)
    try:
        structural = _validation_errors(result_value, _definition("ModelResultEnvelope"), "$")
    except KeyError, TypeError, ValueError:
        return ("model-result-structure-invalid",)
    if structural:
        return tuple(structural)
    result = cast(Mapping[str, Any], result_value)
    errors: list[str] = []
    for key, code in (
        ("taskId", "result-task-id-matches-task"),
        ("taskKind", "result-task-kind-matches-task"),
        ("requestHash", "result-request-hash-matches-task"),
        ("traceId", "result-trace-id-matches-task"),
    ):
        if result[key] != task[key]:
            errors.append(code)
    output = _record(result["output"])
    route = cast(Mapping[str, Any], result["route"])
    policy = cast(Mapping[str, Any], result["policyDecision"])
    validation = cast(Mapping[str, Any], result["validation"])
    requirements = cast(Mapping[str, Any], task["requirements"])
    successful = result["status"] in ("succeeded", "degraded")
    if successful:
        if output is None or output.get("kind") != task["taskKind"]:
            errors.append("successful-result-output-kind-matches-task-kind")
        if route["selection"] != "selected" or validation["outcome"] != "accepted" or policy["outcome"] != "allowed":
            errors.append("successful-result-requires-selected-route-and-accepted-validation")
    elif result["output"] is not None:
        errors.append("non-success-result-carries-no-output")
    latency = cast(Mapping[str, int], result["latency"])
    if latency["totalMs"] < latency["queueMs"] + latency["executionMs"]:
        errors.append("latency-total-covers-queue-and-execution")
    if successful and latency["totalMs"] > requirements["deadlineMs"]:
        errors.append("successful-result-within-task-deadline")
    usage = cast(Mapping[str, Any], result["usage"])
    if usage["reporting"] == "reported":
        token_values = (usage["inputTokens"], usage["outputTokens"], usage["totalTokens"])
        if (
            any(value is None for value in token_values)
            or usage["totalTokens"] != usage["inputTokens"] + usage["outputTokens"]
        ):
            errors.append("reported-token-total-equals-input-plus-output")
        elif (
            usage["inputTokens"] > requirements["maxInputTokens"]
            or usage["outputTokens"] > requirements["maxOutputTokens"]
        ):
            errors.append("reported-usage-within-task-bounds")
    elif any(usage[key] is not None for key in ("inputTokens", "outputTokens", "totalTokens")):
        errors.append("unreported-token-values-are-null")
    artifact = _record(output.get("artifact")) if output is not None else None
    if validation["outcome"] == "accepted":
        if validation["outputHash"] is None or validation["errorCodes"]:
            errors.append("accepted-validation-has-output-hash-and-no-errors")
        if artifact is not None and validation["outputHash"] != artifact["contentHash"]:
            errors.append("accepted-artifact-validation-hash-matches-output")
        if not successful:
            errors.append("accepted-validation-requires-successful-output")
    if validation["outcome"] == "rejected":
        if validation["outputHash"] is None or not validation["errorCodes"]:
            errors.append("rejected-validation-has-output-hash-and-errors")
        if result["status"] != "failed":
            errors.append("rejected-validation-requires-failed-status")
    if validation["outcome"] == "not-run" and (validation["outputHash"] is not None or validation["errorCodes"]):
        errors.append("not-run-validation-has-no-output-or-errors")
    citations = cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], result["citations"])
    if (result["citationStatus"] == "supplied") != bool(citations):
        errors.append("citation-status-matches-citations")
    if citations:
        task_input = cast(Mapping[str, Any], task["input"])
        inputs = {
            (item["aggregateId"], item["revisionId"], item["contentHash"]) for item in _content_references(task_input)
        }
        if any(
            (item["sourceAggregateId"], item["sourceRevisionId"], item["sourceContentHash"]) not in inputs
            for item in citations
        ):
            errors.append("supplied-citations-close-over-task-input-references")
    if (
        successful
        and requirements["citationRequirement"] == "required"
        and (not citations or result["citationStatus"] != "supplied")
    ):
        errors.append("required-citations-are-supplied")
    if requirements["citationRequirement"] == "not-applicable" and (
        result["citationStatus"] != "not-applicable" or citations
    ):
        errors.append("not-applicable-citations-are-empty")
    if (
        requirements["citationRequirement"] != "not-applicable"
        and not citations
        and result["citationStatus"] != "not-supplied"
    ):
        errors.append("citation-status-matches-task-requirement")
    execution = cast(Mapping[str, Any], task["execution"])
    if (
        execution["mode"] == "pinned"
        and route["selection"] == "selected"
        and not _selected_route_matches_pin(route, execution)
    ):
        errors.append("pinned-execution-route-matches-result-route")
    if successful and output is not None and output.get("kind") == task["taskKind"]:
        errors.extend(_indexed_output_errors(task, result))
    diagnostics = cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], result["diagnostics"])
    if result["status"] == "unsupported" and (
        route["selection"] != "none"
        or policy["outcome"] != "denied"
        or validation["outcome"] != "not-run"
        or "model-task-feature-unsupported" not in {item["code"] for item in diagnostics}
    ):
        errors.append("unsupported-required-features-fail-explicitly")
    if result["status"] == "denied" and (route["selection"] != "none" or policy["outcome"] != "denied"):
        errors.append("denied-result-has-no-route")
    return tuple(errors)


def decode_model_result(task: object, value: object) -> ModelResultSnapshot | None:
    try:
        owned = _owned_frozen(value)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    if model_result_errors(task, owned):
        return None
    return cast(ModelResultSnapshot, owned)
